Through the Applied AI & GenAI lens, the operating reality: Grocery runs on the thinnest margins and the shortest freshness clocks: ordering precision, waste reduction and store labor efficiency decide survival. Fresh-chain intelligence, demand by day-part, markdown automation, cold-chain truth, is the difference.

Point fixes for markdown timing manual, a script here, a spreadsheet there, have usually been tried in Grocery & Convenience. This page is the structured version: one capability, one owner, one evidence trail.

Inside Grocery & Convenience, Achala runs Applied AI & Generative AI under the same delivery standard as every engagement: Achala builds pricing, assortment and store-operations decision systems under PCI DSS — decisions per store, per day, measured on margin. The baseline is signed before delivery starts.

items: Markdown decisions by manager instinct; waste too high, margin too low.

Store ordering anchored to history; seasonal and local shifts missed.
